ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The Persian catechism's lists are infinitives in the Russian and stay infinitives ('To do good deeds…'), with «ближний» (blizhniy, 'neighbor') restored; the plural «добрых… злых» (dobrykh… zlykh, 'the good… the evil') and the singular «злого… доброго» (zlogo… dobrogo, 'evil… good') are kept distinct. Attributions follow the print, restoring «Индийская» (Indiyskaya, 'Indian') before the Agni Purana and rendering «изречение» (izrechenie) as 'saying'.
